_what: The ACCOUNT-LEVEL Vast rental hold. Checked in gpu_backend.VastBackend.submit, the only place in this repository that creates a Vast rental (PUT /asks/{id}/). Every lane goes through it: ternary, congeneric fan-out, protfep, nrv04, bioemu, the ternary watchdog — and any lane added later.
_how_to_resume: Delete this file and commit. Nothing else. Every lane's banked checkpoints are untouched and each resumes from its last COMMITTED state.
_what_keeps_running: CREATION only is gated. destroy, stop, collect and every reap path are untouched — a stood-down account must still tear down a host that somehow exists, or 'stood down' quietly becomes 'billing unwatched'.
reason: Vast has not been used in a month and is not to be driven at all (trimcrae, 2026-08-26). This is the account-level expression of that instruction: rather than repeating a hold in each of six lanes — and missing the seventh — the lock sits on the one door they all rent through.
